components.name: Checkout bar
components.description: Checkout bar — the sticky bottom bar that moves the order forward. Cart: Info wrap + full-width “Go to cart · total”. Checkout: total + Pay with a legal line. Floating: a compact accent pill over the menu while items are in the cart. Bottom padding includes the home indicator.
